title: hai saniye zehra ke pisar auno mohammad
body:
hai saniye zehra ke pisar auno mohammad
shabbir ke hai noore nazar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
unke ruqe pur noor se ek noor ayaa'n hai
hai rashke dah shamso qamar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaat'te maidaan me bin saad ke sar ko
wallah jawaa'n hote agar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
saaye ki tarha sath imaamat ke the hamraah
shabbir ke the seena sipar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas chalo dekhne bachou ki ladayi
lakho hai idhar aur udhar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
ye baap ki aashoor ko karte hai nihayat
goya hai tamannaye pidar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ke nawaase hai to jaffer ke hai pote
hai naqle shujaa'at ke samar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hyderi andaaz se maidaan me jaana
lag jaaye na ab tumko nazar auno mohammad
